title: 2015 HMMT November Theme Problem 1
statement: Consider a \(1 \times 1\) grid of squares. Let \(A, B, C, D\) be the vertices of this square, and let \(E\) be the midpoint of segment \(C D\). Furthermore, let \(F\) be the point on segment \(B C\) satisfying \(B F=2 C F\), and let \(P\) be the intersection of lines \(A F\) and \(B E\). Find \(\frac{A P}{P F}\).

solutions.text:
Answer: 3
Let line \(B E\) hit line \(D A\) at \(Q\). It's clear that triangles \(A Q P\) and \(F B P\) are similar so

\[\frac{A P}{P F}=\frac{A Q}{B F}=\frac{2 A D}{\frac{2}{3} B C}=3\]
